title: P104: prove joint helper/cache funding ceiling below kappa 0.0038
body:
## Summary
Complete optimistic cost ceiling for combining helper restrictions, zero MOVE deletions and owned-history caches on #7481 with the 17-call #7113 caller.

## Result
For f(r)=r^(1-kappa), native saving <= f(5)+f(3)+2f(1)-2f(4) on 0<=kappa<=.01. At .0038 the 17-call upper moment is <-25.25810999183538; its restricted ceiling is near .0037347911502843963.

## Verification
Exact component and debit proofs, independent integer-power invoice, normal/optimized and read-only replay plus negative controls. Reproduce: `python3 -B scripts/research_package.py --package research/p104-joint-helper-cache-funding-bound`.

## Scope and kappa
An exclusion ceiling, NOT an achieved kappa. Fixed original histories and whole MOVE jobs; novel public caches, changed producers, decoded jobs and other models remain open. All five foundational assumptions remain.

## Credit and details
#7481, #7113, #7307 and source notices credited. Prepared for @CubeJerry with OpenAI assistance; original notices retained. See `research/p104-joint-helper-cache-funding-bound/PR-DESCRIPTION.md` and `VALIDATION.json` for full proof, pins and controls. Canonical base `e54523517d0f03e58352e647c403a5af3e525a57`; no independent human/formal acceptance claimed.
